headline.purpose: Oversized line names and primary navigational declarations.

title.purpose: Flavor names, stage captions, and search results.

body.purpose: Product descriptions and editorial reading copy.

components.name: Search Trigger
components.description: Quiet underlined utility for opening the full-screen search takeover.
components.css: .ds-search-trigger { border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 234, 219, 0.5); background: transparent; padding: 0 0 0.75rem; color: var(--paper-light, #f2eadb); font: 400 0.68rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.28em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-trigger:hover { color: #fff8eb; } .ds-search-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--paper-light, #f2eadb); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-search-trigger:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-search-mark { display: inline-block; position: relative; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin-left: 1.2rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-search-mark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: -4px; bottom: -2px; width: 5px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Line Rail Item
components.description: Monumental numbered line navigation rendered as a full-width editorial band.
components.css: .ds-line-rail { width: 100%; min-height: 116px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20% 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(232, 220, 198, 0.24); background: transparent; color: rgba(242, 234, 219, 0.42); padding: 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.35s ease, transform 0.35s ease; } .ds-line-rail span { font: 400 4.5rem/0.8 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-line-rail strong { font: 400 3.6rem/0.82 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-line-rail em { font: 400 0.62rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; font-style: normal; opacity: 0; } .ds-line-rail:hover, .ds-line-rail:focus-visible { color: var(--paper-light, #f2eadb); transform: translateX(0.55rem); outline: none; } .ds-line-rail:hover em, .ds-line-rail:focus-visible em { opacity: 1; } .ds-line-rail:active { transform: translateX(0.35rem); }

components.name: Flavor Row
components.description: Printed-index navigation row for entering a specific flavor experience.
components.css: .ds-flavor-row { min-height: 112px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7% 37% 1fr 2rem; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(22, 11, 9, 0.26)); color: var(--ink, #160b09); text-decoration: none; } .ds-flavor-row span { font: 400 0.66rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-flavor-row strong { font: 400 4.2rem/0.9 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; transition: transform 0.4s ease; } .ds-flavor-row small { font: 400 0.72rem/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-flavor-row i { font: 400 1.5rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; font-style: normal; } .ds-flavor-row:hover strong, .ds-flavor-row:focus-visible strong { transform: translateX(1rem); } .ds-flavor-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wine, #4b0713); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-flavor-row:active strong { transform: translateX(0.7rem); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Full-width monumental input used inside the paper search takeover.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label" for="ds-search">FLAVOR, NOTE OR LINE</label><input class="ds-search-field" id="ds-search" placeholder="SEARCH" />
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: block; color: var(--wine, #4b0713); font: 400 0.68rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-search-field { width: 100%; margin-top: 2rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wine, #4b0713); outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--wine, #4b0713); padding: 0; font: 400 clamp(5rem, 15vw, 15rem)/0.8 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-search-field::placeholder { color: rgba(75, 7, 19, 0.58); } .ds-search-field:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--ink, #160b09); } .ds-search-field:focus-visible { border-bottom-width: 2px; } .ds-search-field:active { border-bottom-color: var(--wine, #4b0713); }

components.name: Variant Tabs
components.description: Compact line switcher embedded in the flavor hero.
components.css: .ds-variant-tabs { display: inline-flex; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 234, 219, 0.35); background: var(--wine, #4b0713); } .ds-variant-tab { border: 0; padding: 1rem 1.4rem; background: transparent; color: rgba(242, 234, 219, 0.45); font: 400 0.65rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-variant-tab:hover, .ds-variant-tab:focus-visible { color: var(--paper, #e8dcc6); outline: none; } .ds-variant-tab:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--paper, #e8dcc6); } .ds-variant-tab:active, .ds-variant-tab.ds-is-active { color: var(--paper, #e8dcc6); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--paper, #e8dcc6); }

components.name: Score Row
components.description: Open editorial characteristic row with a thin lacquer progress track.
components.css: .ds-score-row { min-height: 76px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22% 1fr 4rem; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(22, 11, 9, 0.26)); color: var(--ink, #160b09); } .ds-score-row span { font: 400 0.68rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-score-track { height: 5px; background: rgba(75, 7, 19, 0.16); } .ds-score-track i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--wine, #4b0713); transition: width 0.5s ease; } .ds-score-row strong { font: 400 2.1rem/1 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; } .ds-score-row:hover .ds-score-track i { filter: brightness(1.2); } .ds-score-row:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--wine, #4b0713); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Next Flavor Link
components.description: Full-bleed lacquer poster linking one flavor story to the next.
components.html: NEXT FLAVORKRIEK
components.css: .ds-next-flavor { min-height: 360px; display: grid; align-content: end; position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 3rem; background: var(--wine, #4b0713); color: var(--paper, #e8dcc6); text-decoration: none; } .ds-next-flavor span { font: 400 0.62rem/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; } .ds-next-flavor strong { max-width: 80%; font: 400 clamp(7rem, 19vw, 14rem)/0.72 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 0.5s ease; } .ds-next-flavor svg { position: absolute; right: 3rem; bottom: 3rem; width: 64px; height: 64px; transition: transform 0.5s ease; } .ds-next-flavor:hover strong, .ds-next-flavor:focus-visible strong { transform: translateX(0.5rem); } .ds-next-flavor:hover svg, .ds-next-flavor:focus-visible svg { transform: translateX(0.5rem); } .ds-next-flavor:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--paper, #e8dcc6); outline-offset: -8px; } .ds-next-flavor:active svg { transform: translateX(0.8rem); }

narrative.overview:
Trofimoff's behaves like an editorial product theatre bound into a working catalogue. Burgundy lacquer creates the immersive field; warm paper and black ink turn the assortment into a rigorous printed index. The product remains the protagonist, while the interface recedes into numbers, hairlines, labels, and monumental condensed words.

Navigation is part of the composition rather than a detached control layer. Full-bleed fields, square seams, cropped scale, and recognizable packshots create tension between physical product staging and archival order. The experience is dense in image and type but sparse in chrome; motion is controlled, tactile, and calm.
keyCharacteristics: Burgundy lacquer, warm paper, off-white, and black ink.
Monumental condensed display type paired with compact neutral utility copy.
Product theatre used as navigation, not as a detached hero above a catalogue grid.
Open full-bleed fields divided by one-pixel rules and hard square seams.
Flavor-specific material colors that extend, but never replace, the core palette.

rules.name: The Lacquer-and-Paper Rule
rules.body: Every major surface belongs either to the immersive wine world or the archival paper world; flavor colors appear only as controlled material chapters.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: On paper, black ink carries copy and structure; on lacquer, warm paper carries both. Do not introduce a separate UI-gray system.

rules.name: The Monument-and-Whisper Rule
rules.body: Display type is enormous and compressed; everything operational is small, widely tracked, and visually quiet. Avoid the anonymous middle scale.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Use Bebas Neue for display and named navigation, and Manrope for all descriptive and utility copy. No third interface face is present.

rules.name: The Open-Field Rule
rules.body: Use edges, rules, and scale to organize space. Do not put catalogue content into centered max-width cards or rounded shells.

rules.name: The Object-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to products, never to interface containers.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting controls and sections are separated by color, one-pixel rules, and composition; no card shadow is used.

rules.name: The Square-Seam Rule
rules.body: Keep buttons, inputs, rows, overlays, and section boundaries square. Circles belong only to symbols and orbital product framing.

dos: Do let recognizable packshots dominate hero and transition moments.
Do compose with full-bleed lacquer and paper fields, asymmetric grids, cropped display type, and one-pixel hairlines.
Do pair pointer hover with an equivalent visible keyboard-focus response.
Do preserve the stacked mobile hierarchy and complete reduced-motion fallback at the shipped 820px breakpoint.
Do use flavor-specific fields as bounded chapters within the core wine-and-paper world.
donts: Don't detach a conventional hero from a generic product-card grid.
Don't introduce rounded cards, pill buttons, glass panels, decorative gradients, or dashboard chrome.
Don't add shadows to interface containers; reserve depth effects for physical product imagery.
Don't shrink the display system into a safe, uniform middle scale.
Don't allow decorative imagery or motion to obscure product identity, navigation, or factual copy.
